verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an inference API platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents no batch endpoint or other way to submit or act on many items in one operation. The 'standby' service tier is only a discounted, deprioritized way to send individual requests, which makes it adjacent rather than a bulk-operations capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Built for batch and background workloads where a retry costs nothing.
